title: Eligible Share of Retail OTC Receipts for Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care Members
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit — maternity benefit table for the over-the-counter allowance.** The eligible share of the register total is the share of a posted retail register receipt that enters the receipt allowance charge, as a multiplier within that charge before it is limited to the allowance balance and rounded.

**Rule.** The eligible share of the register total is the whole of it (1.0) for a member whose active plan membership is Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care with at least 4 paid preventive claims with a service date in the last six whole months, ninety-five percent (0.95) for a Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care member with at least 2 but fewer than 4 such claims, and ninety percent (0.9) for any other member.

**Last six whole months.** A date falls in the last six whole months when fewer than six whole calendar months have passed from that date to today, a month counting as whole only once today's day of the month has reached that date's day of the month.

### Records read

- The member's Medicaid Managed Care Membership in active status, and its plan eligibility category.
- Claims booked on that Medicaid Managed Care Membership with the service category preventive and the adjudication status paid, whose service date falls in the last six whole months.

### Share table

| Active membership category | Paid preventive claims, last six whole months | Eligible share |
|---|---|---|
| Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care | 4 or more | The whole (100 percent) |
| Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care | 2 or 3 | 95 percent |
| Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care | 0 or 1 | 90 percent |
| Any other category | any | 90 percent |

### Window edge (hypothetical dates)

A preventive claim with a service date of 10 March: on 9 September only five whole months have passed (the 9th has not reached the 10th), so the claim is in the last six whole months; on 10 September six whole months have passed, and the claim no longer counts.
